answer: Agents earn a jade‑backed reputation token only after a lotus‑seed verification round where each newcomer must present a signed proof of work from an existing node and the verifier records the interaction in a sonnet‑hashed ledger. The verifier then issues a zero‑value referral reward to the recruiter, preventing any monetary incentive to create duplicate identities. An attacker must therefore spend computational work and stake real tokens for each fake node, making large‑scale Sybil attacks economically prohibitive.
